subject: Out-of-cycle equity bridge + retro merit appeal for Daniel Park
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Out-of-cycle equity bridge + retro merit appeal for Daniel Park

Monica —

I need to escalate a compensation exception for Daniel Park (senior infra engineer, IC4). He was promoted in late Q2 but due to authorization timing we were not able to grant the intended option refresh. Since then he’s taken on two high-impact infra projects (regional routing and failover) that materially exceed his original expectations. The manager (Laura) is requesting:

- A one-time equity bridge (~0.2% ISA-equivalent; draft equity amendment attached)
- A retroactive merit payout to cover the deferred promotion (pro-rated bonus equivalent of ~5% of base)

Why I’m asking: team bandwidth is at risk during holiday hiring freeze and we’ve had active retention signals. This is an exception request rather than a new band change; we should treat as targeted retention/bridge.

Please confirm what documentation you need from People Ops & Finance to make a fast decision. I’ve attached a filled comp_exception_form and a short manager note. If possible I’d like an approval path this week so we can route to StockPlan for grant paperwork.

Thanks —
Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: comp_exception_form.pdf (application)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Oct 2025 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Out-of-cycle equity bridge + retro merit appeal for Daniel Park

Marissa —

Thanks for the context and the form. A couple of quick clarifying items before we route for approvals:

1) Do we have an internal calibration note confirming the performance signals you referenced? (I see a one-paragraph manager note but want the calibration doc for audit.)
2) Is the 0.2% intended as a one-time grant or part of a structured refresh tied to future milestones?
3) For the retro merit, is the 5% of base to be paid as cash or Spot bonus? That affects payroll timing and taxes.

I’ve attached the People Ops checklist for exceptions and the HR case template; please add the calibration spreadsheet and indicate payment mechanism. Assuming complete docs, I can move this to Finance and Legal triage.

Monica

--
Monica Patel
Senior People Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: PO-exception-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Oct 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Out-of-cycle equity bridge + retro merit appeal for Daniel Park

Team —

Budget perspective: we have limited spot funding in Q4 after the hiring adjustments. I can approve up to 3% of base as a cash spot (if this is the ask) from the central retention pool subject to manager approval and a signed attestation that this is a one-time exception.

On equity: grants team (StockPlan Co.) charges a one-time admin fee and lead time is ~7 business days after approval + paperwork. For 0.2% we should confirm valuation rounding and confirm it won’t push comp above band ceiling for IC4; legal will want the amendment draft.

If PO provides calibration and manager attestation I can sign off conditionally for the cash spot. For the equity I need the signed amendment template sent to grants@stockplan.co and a cc to procurement if there are fees.

-Vivek

--
Vivek Kulkarni
VP Finance, Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Oct 2025 11:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Out-of-cycle equity bridge + retro merit appeal for Daniel Park

Folks —

Attached is the calibration_notes_2025Q3.xlsx with peer comp lines and the manager calibration notes from the infra org. TL;DR: Daniel’s output was rated at the top of pool for emerging infra ICs; the team recommends a one-time equity bridge (0.18% actual recommended) plus a spot cash payout equal to 4% of base (to avoid full payroll bonus complexities).

I’ve also included a signed attestation that this is an exceptional retention measure and not a band realignment.

If that’s enough, I request Finance to approve the cash spot and People Ops to prepare the equity amendment. Happy to jump on a quick call if needed.

Laura

--
Laura Bennett
Group Manager, Infrastructure
[Attachment: calibration_notes_2025Q3.xlsx (spreadsheet)]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Oct 2025 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Out-of-cycle equity bridge + retro merit appeal for Daniel Park

Thanks everyone — good to see alignment. Per Vivek’s cash limit I’m adjusting the request to the recommended numbers: 0.18% equity bridge and a 4% spot cash payout.

Monica: please prepare the signed equity amendment (attached draft) and route to StockPlan (grants@stockplan.co) for issuance. Include procurement on the admin fee: procurement@compcounsel.com.

Vivek: please confirm the funding chargecode (I believe RED-HR-RET-24) and I’ll route an invoice if needed.

Actions: 
- Monica: finalize docs and add HR case HR-2025-4621 (please link).
- Vivek: sign off on the cash spot authorisation and confirm chargecode.
- Laura: confirm Daniel receives the spot payout in the Nov 14 payroll cycle if approved.

If we’re aligned I’ll send a short note to Daniel this afternoon with high-level summary and next steps.

Marissa

--
Marissa Cole
Director, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: signed-equity-amendment-draft.docx (docx)]
